questions.prompt: How many total individual steel staples are used in the cardboard packaging of all shipments processed by major shipping hubs in Singapore in a single year?
reasoning: Major shipping hubs in Singapore process roughly 50 million packages annually.
On average, a standard cardboard shipping box is secured with about 1 string or multiple metal staples, averaging around 1 staple per box.
Multiplying the 50 million packages by an average of 0.9 staples per box yields approximately 45 million staples.

questions.prompt: How many total grams of organic matter are consumed by all pet ferrets kept in households across Sweden in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 10000 pet ferrets kept in homes across Sweden.
An average adult ferret eats about 50 grams of specialized food and meat daily.
Multiplying 10,000 ferrets by 50 grams per day gives 500,000 grams consumed daily nationwide.
Multiplying the daily total by 365 days yields 18,250,000 grams in a single year.

questions.prompt: How many total individual wool threads are used in the weaving of all official academic graduation gowns manufactured for universities in Australia in a single year?
reasoning: Australian universities award degrees to about 300,000 graduating students each year who require gowns.
A standard academic graduation gown contains roughly 1,200 vertical and horizontal structural woven wool threads forming the fabric matrix.
Multiplying 300,000 gowns by 1,200 threads per gown results in a total of 360,000,000 threads.
